en: The postcard features a black-and-white winter photograph of a public square, with large snow piles and ornate street lamps in the foreground. The background consists of multi-story stone buildings with classical facades and snow-covered roofs. Some shop names are visible on the buildings. The bottom of the image has printed red text labeling the location as 'Sundsvall. Vängåfvan.' The reverse side of the postcard includes handwritten Swedish text, addresses, a green Swedish stamp of 5 öre, and multilingual 'CARTE POSTALE' headings.
